app.title: Figson Converter
app.description: Convert Figma frames to AI-ready exports

export.heading: Export selection
export.description: Select a frame or component in Figma, then convert with your preferred detail and format.

precise.label: Precise
precise.hint: Full cleaned JSON — best fidelity, largest token use.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.hint: Removes noise like IDs and layout metadata — good default.

efficient.label: Efficient
efficient.hint: Semantic compression — smallest tokens, best for LLM prompts.

yaml.label: YAML
yaml.hint: Compact DSL — excellent readability with fewer tokens.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.hint: Sectioned outline — easy to chunk for LLM context.

text.label: Text
text.hint: Tiny text summary — fastest to scan, least detail.

output.title: Export preview
output.empty: Convert a selection to see the {{format}} preview here.
output.hint: Adjust detail level and format above, then download when ready.

infoModal.title: How to use Figson Converter
infoModal.description: Follow these steps to turn Figma selections into AI-ready exports.

warning.title: Model output can vary
warning.description: Different AI models may interpret the same export differently. Treat the preview as a starting point and validate results in your workflow.
warning.screenshotTip: Include screenshots alongside the export when possible — visual context helps models understand layout, spacing, and styling more reliably.

selectFrame.title: Select a frame or component
selectFrame.description: In Figma, select the frame, component, or section you want to convert.

chooseSettings.title: Choose detail level and format
chooseSettings.description: Pick how much structure to keep and which export format fits your AI tool best.

convertAndPreview.title: Convert and review the preview
convertAndPreview.description: Run Convert, then inspect the preview before downloading.

downloadExport.title: Download the export
downloadExport.description: Save the file and attach it to your AI prompt or automation flow.

detailLevels.heading: Detail level differences
detailLevels.description: Pick the trade-off between design fidelity and token size.

precise.title: Precise
precise.description: Keeps the fullest cleaned structure — spacing, styles, hierarchy, component detail, blend modes, transforms, and prototype interactions (triggers, actions, transitions) stay intact. Best when the model must closely reproduce the design. Uses the most tokens.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.description: Strips low-value noise such as IDs and raw layout metadata while preserving meaningful structure, styles, blend modes, and prototype interactions. A strong default for most AI workflows and medium-sized frames.

efficient.title: Efficient
efficient.description: Applies semantic compression to produce the smallest export. Drops transforms, prototype interactions, and most visual metadata. Best for large frames, iterative prompts, and cases where approximate layout understanding is enough.
